pairs.name: Batrider
pairs.reason: Batrider has an easy time getting close to an immobile Nature's Prophet with Sticky Napalm stacks and Firefly, which also breaks the Sprout trees to maintain vision and keep on top of him. Nature's Prophet also struggles to Teleport away because of the long duration Flaming Lasso lockdown. Flamebreak also breaks Sprout trees when a unit that is pushed collides with a tree.

pairs.name: Broodmother
pairs.reason: Nature's Prophet can never trap or hold back Broodmother or her Spiderlings with Sprout while they are in the AoE of one of her Webs. Broodmother also has an easy time running at a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet and burst him down before he can Teleport away. However, Broodmother has to be careful about the damage from Sprout and Wrath of Nature as it can kill most of her Spider army.

pairs.name: Dawnbreaker
pairs.reason: Dawnbreaker's Celestial Hammer gives her mobility to get on top of a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet while breaking his Sprout trees to maintain vision of him. Dawnbreaker can also use one of her teammates to use Solar Guardian to get close to Nature's Prophet while saving her ally caught inside Sprout. Dawnbreaker's high damage through her spells and right clicks also helps deal with Treants throughout the game.

pairs.name: Doom
pairs.reason: Doom easily counters the Treants from Nature's Prophet with just a single level in Devour to get rid of them instantly. Level 1 Devour works on Level 4 Treants, and can instantly kill the strong Treant from the Ironwood Treant facet. Doom also has an easy time of running at a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet during Scorched Earth and kill him every time Doom is off cooldown.

pairs.name: Earthshaker
pairs.reason: Earthshaker's spell combo makes short work of a squishy Nature's Prophet in every fight, as Echo Slam makes use of the Treant summons to do even more damage. Once Earthshaker gets Aghanim's Scepter, he also has a natural way of getting out of the Sprout trees every time with Enchant Totem.

pairs.name: Elder Titan
pairs.reason: Elder Titan's Astral Spirit makes use of the Treant summons from Nature's Prophet to give him even more damage and movement speed upon returning. This lets him run at Nature's Prophet as well as deal with his Treants with the mobility and damage. Elder Titan also has multiple long distance lockdown spells in Earth Splitter and Echo Stomp through Astral Spirit to stop the Teleportation of Nature's Prophet.

pairs.name: Ember Spirit
pairs.reason: Despite being a melee hero, Ember Spirit does most of his damage from a long distance with the Sleight of Fish and Searing Chains combo to maintain the upper hand on a squishy Nature's Prophet. The mobility from Fire Remnant also lets Ember Spirit break Sprout trees and get on top of a squishy Nature's Prophet to burst him down.

pairs.name: Faceless Void
pairs.reason: Faceless Void's Chronosphere lets him lock down and kill a squishy Nature's Prophet every time while he cannot fight back or defend himself. Nature's Prophet also struggles to get away from Faceless Void or hold him back with Sprout and Faceless Void can easily get outside or around the trees with Time Walk.

pairs.name: Invoker
pairs.reason: Invoker has multiple ways of stopping the Nature's Prophet Teleportation channel to ensure he does not get to join or get away from fights. Nature's Prophet also likes to play away from his team and split push lanes, which makes him an easy target for Invoker to find with Ghost Walk and finish off with his spell combo.

pairs.name: Kez
pairs.reason: Kez's high mobility lets him find easy kills on a squishy Nature's Prophet since he has no defensive tools to kite or get away from him. The Talon Toss silence also ensures Nature's Prophet cannot complete his Teleportation. Kez is also hard to deter with Sprout as he can chop down one of the trees with Grappling Claw to either escape or maintain the chase on Nature's Prophet.

pairs.name: Lina
pairs.reason: Lina's massive damage through her spell combo makes short work of a squishy Nature's Prophet to give her easy kills throughout the game. Light Strike Array also breaks trees, allowing Lina to get out of Sprout or find Nature's Prophet if he tries to hide himself and Teleport away. Lina's high damage through her spells and right clicks also helps deal with the strong Treant from the Ironwood Treant facet.

pairs.name: Meepo
pairs.reason: Meepo's high burst damage through right clicks and multiple Poofs from his clones gets him easy kills on a squishy Nature's Prophet throughout the game. Meepo also has plenty of Earthbind casts through his clones to stop the Teleportation of Nature's Prophet. Nature's Prophet also doesn't have a ton of damage or lockdown to burst down Meepo or control his clones when fighting back.

pairs.name: Monkey King
pairs.reason: Monkey King's mobility with Tree Dance and Primal Spring lets him find and jump a squishy Nature's Prophet, who struggles to get away with Sprout because of Tree Dance. The Boundless Strike stun also helps stop the Teleportation from Nature's Prophet and burst him down before he gets away. The armor gain from Wukong's Command also negates a lot of physical damage dished out by Nature's Prophet.

pairs.name: Muerta
pairs.reason: Muerta's Dead Shot lets her break a tree, which gives her an easy escape from Sprout while fearing Nature's Prophet with the ricochet targeted towards him. Muerta can also use Pierce the Veil to burst down Nature's Prophet while not letting him do any right click damage. The Calling silence also stops Nature's Prophet from Teleporting away.

pairs.name: Naga Siren
pairs.reason: Naga Siren has an easy time of running at a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet to lock him down Ensnare and burst him down with her illusions. The Song of the Siren and Ensnare also prevent Nature's Prophet from Teleporting away. Naga Siren also counters the split push from Nature's Prophet and his Treants with her own split push through Mirror Image illusions, which lets her push multiple lanes at once.

pairs.name: Pangolier
pairs.reason: Pangolier's massive damage and lockdown with his spells makes short work of a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet and gives him easy kills. Rolling Thunder breaks trees in its path, letting Pangolier get in and out of Sprout to maintain the chase on Nature's Prophet. The mobility from Swashbuckle and Shield Crash also help deal with Sprout and kill Nature's Prophet and his Treants at the same time.

pairs.name: Pudge
pairs.reason: Pudge gets easy Meat Hooks on a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet when he hides himself inside Sprout, or tries to stand and throw right clicks. A follow up Dismember and the run down during Rot lets Pudge finish him off as he has no natural ability to get away from Pudge. Pudge can also Hook and instantly kill the stronger Treant summoned by Nature's Prophet with his Ironwood Treant facet, taking away a lot of his damage.

pairs.name: Queen of Pain
pairs.reason: Queen of Pain gets to whittle away the HP of Nature's Prophet with Shadow Strike in lane to maintain kill threat on him at all times. Later in the game, Queen of Pain's Blink lets her close the gap on a squishy Nature's Prophet and burst him down together with his strong Treant from the Ironwood Treant facet with her AoE burst damage through Sonic Wave and Scream of Pain. Blink also lets Queen of Pain easily get in and out of Sprout. The Dagon purchase also helps against both Nature's Prophet and his Treants.

pairs.name: Spectre
pairs.reason: Spectre has an easy time getting on top of a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet with Shadow Step and running him down under the slow from Spectral Dagger. The phased movement on the Spectral Dagger path allows Spectre to move through Sprout trees to not allow Nature's Prophet to get away from her or slow her down.

pairs.name: Spirit Breaker
pairs.reason: Spirit Breaker counters the split push strategy of Nature's Prophet with his global Charge of Darkness to find and kill him every time he shows on the map to clear creep waves. The lockdown from Nether Strike and Greater Bash easily stops Nature's Prophet from Teleporting away. Charge of Darkness also allows Spirit Breaker to get away when trapped inside the Sprout trees.

pairs.name: Storm Spirit
pairs.reason: Storm Spirits mobility through Ball Lightning lets him get on top of a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet and burst him down with his spells and right clicks during the Electric Vortex lockdown. Ball Lightning also breaks trees, which allows Storm Spirit to get in and out of Sprout to maintain the chase on Nature's Prophet. The catch from Ball Lightning also helps deal with the split push from Nature's Prophet and his Treants.

pairs.name: Timbersaw
pairs.reason: All of Timbersaw's active abilities cut trees, which makes the Nature's Prophet Sprout completely ineffective against him. Timbersaw can use the Sprout trees to deal even more damage with Whirling Death by cutting more trees in its AoE. Timbersaw's burst damage with his spells easily kills a squishy Nature's Prophet before he can get away with Teleportation.

pairs.name: Tinker
pairs.reason: Tinker counters the split push from Nature's Prophet and his Treants by getting to lanes with Keen Conveyance and killing creep waves safely with March of the Machines. Tinker's Defense Matrix also absorbs a lot of the damage dealt by Nature's Prophet with his right clicks and Wrath of Nature, effectively nullifying his burst potential. Nature's Prophet also has no way of stopping Rearm and the Keen Conveyance teleportation.

pairs.name: Underlord
pairs.reason: Underlord's Fiend's Gate deals with the split push from Nature's Prophet by getting on top of him every time he shows on the lane to clear creep waves. The root from Pit of Malice stops Nature's Prophet from getting away with Teleportation. Underlord also deals plenty of damage with Firestorm and his right clicks to deal with the strong Treant from the Ironwood Treant facet.

pairs.name: Visage
pairs.reason: Visage and his Familiars have an easy time running at a squishy and immobile Nature's Prophet during the slow from Grave Chill to kill him every time. The Familiars have flying movement, which lets them get in and out of Sprout to maintain vision of Nature's Prophet, and their Stone Form stuns him to stop him from Teleporting away. Nature's Prophet also has no good way of getting through the Gravekeeper's Cloak layers.
